hooks.command: export EVERMEM_API_KEY="$(security find-generic-password -s evermem-api -w 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n')" EVERMEM_USER_ID=cloud-runner EVERMEM_AGENTIC=1 EVERMEM_GROUP_ID=fincept && if [ -z "$EVERMEM_API_KEY" ]; then echo '[EverMem] WARN: keychain entry evermem-api missing — run: security add-generic-password -U -s evermem-api -a "$USER" -w <key>'; else echo '[EverMem] cloud-runner/fincept initialized'; fi
